text_en: These are the descendants of Noah’s sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth; children were born to them after the flood.
text_cn: 以下是诺厄的儿子闪、含、和耶斐特的后裔。洪水以后，他们都生了子孙。

text_en: The descendants of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
text_cn: 耶斐特的子孙：哥默尔、玛哥格、玛待、雅汪、突巴耳、默舍客和提辣斯。

text_en: The descendants of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
text_cn: 哥默尔的子孙：阿市革纳次、黎法特和托加尔玛。

text_en: The descendants of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
text_cn: 雅汪的子孙：厄里沙、塔尔史士、基廷和多丹。

text_en: From these the coastland peoples spread. These are the descendants of Japheth in their lands, with their own language, by their families, in their nations.
text_cn: 那些分布于岛上的民族，就是出于这些人：以上这些人按疆域、语言、宗族和国籍，都属耶斐特的子孙。

text_en: The descendants of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put, and Canaan.
text_cn: 含的子孙：雇士、米兹辣殷、普特和客纳罕。

text_en: The descendants of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The descendants of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
text_cn: 雇士的子孙：色巴、哈威拉、撒贝达、辣阿玛和撒贝特加。辣阿玛的子孙：舍巴和德丹。

text_en: Cush became the father of Nimrod; he was the first on earth to become a mighty warrior.
text_cn: 雇士生尼默洛得，他是世上第一个强人。

text_en: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord ; therefore it is said, “Like Nimrod a mighty hunter before the Lord . ”
text_cn: 他在上主面前是个有本领的猎人，为此有句俗话说：“如在上主面前，有本领的猎人尼默洛得。”

text_en: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, and Accad, all of them in the land of Shinar.
text_cn: 他开始建国于巴比伦、厄勒客和阿加得，都在史纳尔地域。

text_en: From that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth-ir, Calah, and
text_cn: 他由那地方去了亚述，建设了尼尼微、勒曷波特城、加拉

text_en: Resen between Nineveh and Calah; that is the great city.
text_cn: 和在尼尼微与加拉之间的勒森(尼尼微即是那大城)。

text_en: Egypt became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
text_cn: 米兹辣殷生路丁人、阿纳明人、肋哈宾人、纳斐突歆人、

text_en: Pathrusim, Casluhim, and Caphtorim, from which the Philistines come.
text_cn: 帕特洛斯人、加斯路人和加非托尔人。培肋舍特人即出自此族。

text_en: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
text_cn: 客纳罕生长子漆冬，以后生赫特、

text_en: and the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
text_cn: 耶步斯人、阿摩黎人、基尔加士人、

text_en: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
text_cn: 希威人、阿尔克人、息尼人、

text_en: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
text_cn: 阿尔瓦得人、责玛黎人和哈玛特人；此后，客纳罕的宗族分散了，

text_en: And the territory of the Canaanites extended from Sidon, in the direction of Gerar, as far as Gaza, and in the direction of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
text_cn: 以致客纳罕人的边疆，自漆冬经过革辣尔直到迦萨，又经过索多玛、哈摩辣、阿德玛和责波殷，直到肋沙。

text_en: These are the descendants of Ham, by their families, their languages, their lands, and their nations.
text_cn: 以上这些人按疆域、语言、宗族和国籍，都属含的子孙。

text_en: To Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth, children were born.
text_cn: 耶斐特的长兄，即厄贝尔所有子孙的祖先闪，也生了儿子。

text_en: The descendants of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
text_cn: 闪的子孙：厄蓝、亚述、阿帕革沙得、路得和阿兰。

text_en: The descendants of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
text_cn: 阿兰的子孙：伍兹、胡耳、革特尔和玛士。

text_en: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah; and Shelah became the father of Eber.
text_cn: 阿帕革沙得生舍拉；舍拉生厄贝尔。

text_en: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided, and his brother’s name was Joktan.
text_cn: 厄贝尔生了两个儿子：一个名叫培肋格，因为在他的时代世界分裂了；他的兄弟名叫约刻堂。

text_en: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
text_cn: 约刻堂生阿耳摩达得、舍肋夫、哈匝玛委特、耶辣、

text_en: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
text_cn: 哈多兰、乌匝耳、狄刻拉、

text_en: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
text_cn: 敖巴耳、阿彼玛耳、舍巴、

text_en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab; all these were the descendants of Joktan.
text_cn: 敖非尔、哈威拉和约巴布：以上都是约刻堂的子孙。

text_en: The territory in which they lived extended from Mesha in the direction of Sephar, the hill country of the east.
text_cn: 他们居住的地域，从默沙经过色法尔直到东面的山地：

text_en: These are the descendants of Shem, by their families, their languages, their lands, and their nations.
text_cn: 以上这些人按疆域、语言、宗族和国籍，都属闪的子孙：

text_en: These are the families of Noah’s sons, according to their genealogies, in their nations; and from these the nations spread abroad on the earth after the flood.
text_cn: 以上这些人按他们的出身和国籍，都是诺厄子孙的家族；洪水以后，地上的民族都是由他们分出来的。
